premise: The meadow asks the wind where it's going; it's too busy to answer — blowing the fog away, spinning the leaves, tumbling Pinecone along and lifting Butterfly into the branches — until it lies down in the grass to rest, and then it whispers: everywhere, and back here tomorrow.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop), turned: the wind isn't a rival to be beaten, just a busy visitor with a secret.
lesson: Some questions are answered by waiting for a quiet moment.

en-US.title: Where the Wind Goes
en-US.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [softly] One morning, the meadow was hidden in fog. Then — {canvas:wind 0.6} {sfx:wind} WHOOSH! — {canvas:fog stop} the wind blew the fog away. {all:face surprised} [curious] "Wind, where are you going?" asked the meadow. But the wind was too busy to stop. {all:wobble 0.5} It tickled the grass. It ruffled the pond. {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} It sent leaves spinning from the trees. {pinecone:enter} Pinecone came rolling by, and the wind {pinecone:go to meadow right} {pinecone:spin} tumbled her along. {pinecone:face happy} [giggles] "Wheee!" {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:face happy} Butterfly let it carry her {butterfly:go to branches right} up into the branches, where she {butterfly:live rest hold} folded her wings and held on. {acorn:enter} Acorn came walking up and {acorn:face surprised} {acorn:live hold-cap} held on to her cap. At last the wind got tired. Whoo… shhh. {canvas:wind stop} {canvas:leaves stop} It lay down in the grass to rest, and everything went still. {butterfly:live rest resume} Butterfly opened her wings. {acorn:live wish} Acorn made a wish: "Now tell us where you're going!" [whispers] And the wind whispered back, so softly only the grass could hear. {all:face happy} [happily] What did it say? "Everywhere… and back here tomorrow."

es-ES.title: ¿Adónde va el viento?
es-ES.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [softly] Una mañana, el prado amaneció escondido en la niebla. Y entonces… {canvas:wind 0.6} {sfx:wind} ¡FIUUU! {canvas:fog stop} Llegó el viento y se llevó la niebla. {all:face surprised} [curious] —Viento, ¿adónde vas? —preguntó el prado. Pero el viento tenía demasiada prisa para pararse. {all:wobble 0.5} Le hizo cosquillas a la hierba. Rizó el agua de la charca. {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} Hizo bailar las hojas de los árboles. {pinecone:enter} Piña pasaba rodando, y el viento {pinecone:go to meadow right} {pinecone:spin} se la llevó dando tumbos. {pinecone:face happy} [giggles] —¡Yupiii! {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:face happy} Mariposa se dejó llevar {butterfly:go to branches right} hasta las ramas, y allí {butterfly:live rest hold} plegó las alas y se agarró fuerte. {acorn:enter} Bellota llegó andando y {acorn:face surprised} {acorn:live hold-cap} se sujetó el sombrerito. Por fin el viento se cansó. Fiuu… chsss. {canvas:wind stop} {canvas:leaves stop} Se tumbó en la hierba a descansar, y todo se quedó quieto. {butterfly:live rest resume} Mariposa abrió las alas. {acorn:live wish} Bellota pidió un deseo: —¡Ahora dinos adónde vas! [whispers] Y el viento contestó, tan bajito que solo lo oyó la hierba. {all:face happy} [happily] ¿Qué dijo? —A todas partes… y mañana, otra vez aquí.
